cameroon.title: Flag of the Republic of Cameroon

colors.note: Hoist-side band evoking the forests of the south and hope for the future.
Central band symbolising unity between the country's regions.
Fly-side band representing the sun and the savannas of the north.

desc:
- Three equal vertical bands of green, red and yellow with a yellow five-pointed star on the red
- The Pan-African palette was introduced in 1957 and the star added in 1975 on reunification
- The star, known as the Star of Unity, marks the fusion of the formerly British and French Cameroons
trivia:
- The 1961-1975 flag had two yellow stars in the green band, one for each former trust territory
- The single central star replaced them after the federal republic became a unitary state
- Cameroon was the first sub-Saharan African country to adopt the Pan-African colours, in 1957
